title: Kilo-code CLI frustrating anti-ux shortcuts
summary: ### Description First of all, thank you guys for keeping kilo cli free and opensource. But let me provide some feedback which perhaps help you to enhance kilo cli ux. Note sure this is a bug, but to me it definately looks like a thing to be fixed. The root cause is semi-standard short cuts. e.g. You can edit selection used standard ways (shift + arrow keys), but for somethings shortcuts are very unexpected. Kilocode CLI shortcuts annoys as hell. 1. When I want to go to a new line, I want (and sometimes press ctrl-enter), and kilocode - just sends it. You've got to cancel AI loop, revert it and continue to edit (recalling that you've got to press ctrl-J for new lines). 2. What just killed my last hour. I was editing task for agent and created quite a good prompt. Then I wanted to copy it to share with team-mate. So I pressed ctrl-c. It it just cleared my prompt. Oh I've got to undo it. So I pressed ctrl-z. And it killed process. So I felt I myself a happy three friends hero, haha. I'm using Linux and its terminals like 20 years or more, and know what ctrl-c and ctrl-z means. Kilo cli makes a delusion of windows-like short-cuts first, and then accidentially fallback to sigterm and friends.
